args.sql:
WITH known_status AS (
  SELECT issue_key, value AS status
  FROM field_versions
  WHERE field = 'status'
    AND valid_from <= TIMESTAMP '2017-12-05 14:29'
    AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > TIMESTAMP '2017-12-05 14:29')
    AND recorded_at <= TIMESTAMP '2017-12-06 01:05'
    AND (superseded_at IS NULL OR superseded_at > TIMESTAMP '2017-12-06 01:05')
), known_category AS (
  SELECT issue_key, value AS category
  FROM field_versions
  WHERE field = 'status_category'
    AND valid_from <= TIMESTAMP '2017-12-05 14:29'
    AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > TIMESTAMP '2017-12-05 14:29')
    AND recorded_at <= TIMESTAMP '2017-12-06 01:05'
    AND (superseded_at IS NULL OR superseded_at > TIMESTAMP '2017-12-06 01:05')
), known_status_since AS (
  SELECT issue_key, max(valid_from) AS status_since
  FROM field_versions
  WHERE field = 'status'
    AND valid_from <= TIMESTAMP '2017-12-05 14:29'
    AND recorded_at <= TIMESTAMP '2017-12-06 01:05'
    AND (superseded_at IS NULL OR superseded_at > TIMESTAMP '2017-12-06 01:05')
  GROUP BY issue_key
)
SELECT i.key
FROM issues i
JOIN known_status s ON i.key = s.issue_key
JOIN known_category c ON i.key = c.issue_key
JOIN known_status_since ss ON i.key = ss.issue_key
WHERE i.project = 'MXS'
  AND s.status = 'Stalled'
  AND c.category = 'indeterminate'
  AND ss.status_since <= TIMESTAMP '2017-11-05 14:29'
ORDER BY i.key
